items.title: F1102K is In-active but still in a current formula
items.detail: IWPFT062 has F1102K (PH401) In-active, yet RP26911-2's new SE43 formula FUA151WB3 uses it in V7 (28 Sep), and SE42 used it on 25 Sep. Replace with F1203K, or reactivate F1102K on IWPFT062.

items.title: One formula code, several recipes
items.detail: On 7 lines the same code is printed with different settings: FUA152WB4 (SE12, SE13, SE31, SE32), FU0021WB4 (SE23, SE25), FUA060WBA twice on SE22 with no note. Some are variants (sign blank, VOIDFORM, run-out); FUA060WBA and RP26512-1's FU0041WB4 / FU0031WB4 have nothing telling the floor which to run.
items.where: SE12 · SE13 · SE21 · SE22 · SE23 · SE25 · SE31 · SE32

items.title: Same code, different weight % on two lines
items.detail: FU0151KS3: virgin 78 / KS 2 in V8 on SE42 (25 Sep), virgin 77 / KS 3 in V9 on SE43 (28 Sep). Is the recipe per line, or should one code mean one recipe?

items.title: Correct two FRM pages
items.detail: SE42 V3 still prints Q1203K (replaced by F1203K) and SE24 prints Bergen XO-256 (is X0-256). The master is already corrected.

items.title: Premix wording on H68A127-1
items.detail: SE23 prints "WB EA Premix" (FU0021GT4); SE25 printed "WB GT Premix" (FU001GTW4). The note names GT D26002M, which IWPFT062 lists as CR400EA. One name for one premix.

items.title: Alternate sources and trade names not on IWPFT062
items.detail: KS black: Spartech B60009 and PolyOne LD-250 are printed as alternates but not qualified; NPC grade printed PE90000F vs PE-B9000F on the list. "BL-B26003A" and "HiTalc ZS" are not named on the list. Add to IWPFT062 or drop from the pages.

items.title: Printed GSM about 7% above the weight range, every VOIDFORM order
items.detail: Every order with a range in its instructions prints a GSM about 7% above the range's middle (631 vs 582-600, 793 vs 729-751, 1052 vs 970-1000). Is the printed GSM a nominal figure and the range the real target?

items.title: Converting sheet figures that don't add up
items.detail: SD22 H64A244-1 prints 1,431,000 sheets vs 560 × 2,700 = 1,512,000; H65A163-1 prints 201.6 for 201,600. Semi sizes differ from the EXT order size on H64A244-1, H69A038-1 and H67A120-1 (two-up?).

items.title: # Plt stops at 999
items.detail: The AS400 field caps at 999: 16 orders a day print 999; two are corrected by hand (1880, 1044). Any order above 999 pallets is understated in the schedule and the records.

items.title: Pallets: remaining or full order?
items.detail: EXT # Plt is sometimes the remaining pallets, sometimes the full order, so the CNV "X OF Y" status can't be checked against it (H68A091-1 786 OF 1880 vs 999; H69A066-2 6 OF 6 vs 1). Also 145 OF 141, 53 OF 52 and board use 237 OF 200.

items.title: Tech's calc workbooks into inputs\calc
items.detail: Blocks the auger-line recipes (weight %), the Auger Calibration master and one test. Also answers where they live (Q14), so the pipeline can read them where Tech saves them.

items.title: Auger rules and slopes
items.detail: Is the draft hopper-role table right (Q13)? Which slope is current where two are in use (Q12)? SE22/SE21 H4 gearbox 1:100 or 1:70 (Q18, a one-minute catch test)? SE32's slopes 11-13% off the others (Q19)?

items.title: FRM vs calc formula codes
items.detail: The same settings carry different codes on the FRM and in the calc (FUA152WB4 vs FUA012WB4 / FUA062WB4). Which is the real code, and what decides the number (Q3, Q8, Q9)? Which source wins when calc, Word book and FRM disagree (Q15)?
